summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new AI Invoice Generator module. All 15 backend pytest tests pass (config, generate, VAT/totals math verified 10x100+2x250 with vat 20 => 1500/300/1800, invalid status 422, versioning v1->v2, restore creates NEW version and logs invoice_restored (not invoice_saved), PDF/DOCX export valid, export-before-save 404). Regression: 32/32 proposal + contract tests still pass — their PDF/DOCX exports untouched. Frontend UI end-to-end verified on /projects/:id: Invoice tab appears between Contract and AI Chat, empty state -> Generate button triggered real LLM (~30s), header shows invoice-number (INV-202607-0001), invoice-title-input, issue/due dates, status Select. Edit mode: instant recompute confirmed (5x100 -> $500 amount, subtotal $7,200 with existing items; VAT 20% -> $1,440, total $8,640). Add line-item, save v1, version history list shows invoice-version-1, export PDF/DOCX + regenerate buttons present. All regression tabs (Overview/Tasks/Proposal/Contract/AI Planner/AI Chat/Proposals/Documents/Notes/Activity) still present.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: /api/projects/{id}/invoice GET returns 200 with body null when no invoice exists (Mongo find_one returns None serialized). Consider returning 404 or empty object for cleaner client contract — frontend currently handles null correctly so non-blocking.

Minor: _next_invoice_number uses count_documents across ALL projects (global counter). If invoices are deleted, numbering can collide. Consider a dedicated monotonic counter collection for production.
seed_data_creation: Test project TEST_INVOICE_MODULE + client TEST_INVOICE_ClientCo created and cleaned up per test module. Real project 'Brand Redesign' now has a saved invoice v1 from UI test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Invoice module fully functional. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_invoice.py is reusable. Instant recompute on frontend validated. LLM generation ~15-30s. ai_invoices collection stores one doc per project. If retesting, ensure DELETE /api/projects/{id} cascades ai_invoices (verified in code line 318).
